building.facade: 북단은 2026-06 cc_01의 갈색 쌍파일런·민트색 입체 유리 랜턴·불투명 원판 C. 남측 8/9번 면은 사진11의 회색 석재 0.6 m 줄눈과 규칙적인 큰 어두운 창. 서측 띠창/OSM 풋프린트 유지.
building.signage: 정문 전체 6.6 m 검은 파시아 위 흰 SHINSEGAE CENTRAL CITY(첫 단어는 흐린 로드뷰의 추정 판독). 불투명 짙은 원판·두꺼운 크림 C·올리브금색 중심. 옛 녹색 다층 안내판은 제외. 홀의 붉은 승차홈 번호와 한국어 안내 유지.
building.entrances: 쌍파일런 중심s=-23.5/t13.2·25.8, 정면s=-26.5. 정문 전폭6.6 m 검은 전실, 문은 정면에서1.7 m 후퇴·중앙2.45 m 개방. 서측 신규18×7.5 m 곡면 지붕 파빌리온 중심세계(-168,-17), 동측 계단입구. gotomall 현 코드에 같은 위치 출입구 없음; 지하 목적지 미확인으로 보이는 얕은 계단과 하단 평범한 마감만 구현. 기존 사진03 출입구는 별개로 보존.
building.scope: 이 모듈은 터미널 포디움, 원형관, 서측 주차 구조물과 호남선 버스 야드. 33층·150 m 수치는 JW 호텔 타워 문헌 맥락으로 이 모듈 높이와 무관. 백화점·호텔 상층 및 별도 6F 밀레니엄홀은 이 9 m 풋프린트의 층으로 만들지 않음.

photo_notes.where: 1F, Famille Station near the bus-arrival side; hoho entrance facing the open atrium
photo_notes.observed: Ivory/cream stone-look pillars and walls, broad low stair steps in front of the shop, glass storefront with dark fascia, large LED board and skylight panels in a pale ceiling; queue of ~6 people at the door. Large open volume, ceiling clearly 5m+.

Frameless full-height glass, rounded yellow square logo "hoho" (lowercase rounded sans, brown line-art smile) hung at about 2.2m. Inside: warm timber slat ceiling with recessed white light panels, light-wood chairs, potted tree.

Wide interior: ceiling of narrow timber battens on cream plaster, cove/indirect light, light oak square tables and slat-back chairs, indoor trees, order tablets; ceiling ~3.5-4m. Dense seating, nearly full.

Dark bronze/brown metal fascia with backlit cream-white Korean characters "호호식당" in a soft serif-like Myeongjo style, small English line at right; fascia ~0.7m high, mounted at ~3m above a glass front. Behind it cream arched-window facade (classical, European street feel).

photo_notes.where: 1F Famille Station, Cha R (차알) frontage on the aisle
photo_notes.observed: Aisle floor in light grey rectangular porcelain tile (stretcher bond), storefront with black steel frame and blue neon "Cha R" sign, brick pier at right, interior floor black/white checkerboard, orange timber bench outside. Low black ceiling grid with spot rails.

Exposed warm brown/orange brick wall, small dark plaque "FAMILLE STATION" (serif caps with ornament) with pink neon script "Here To Delight You!" above; floor charcoal tile; dark ceiling. Sign plaque ~0.5m wide at about 1.7m height.
Red leatherette booths with turquoise trim, mustard-yellow walls, green window frames, recessed downlights in white ceiling; American-Chinese diner look (restaurant-specific).

Black/white checkerboard floor, bentwood chairs, steel-grey tables, mustard yellow wall, glazed timber partition with green mullions, round framed pictures, ceiling ~3m with downlights and AC cassette.

photo_notes.where: 1F Famille Station, Buddha's Belly storefront (street-like frontage)
photo_notes.observed: Brick-clad frontage (orange-red brick piers), dark open-front shop with backlit blue sign "BUDDHA'S BELLY" white caps in a flared serif; queue of 4 people; ceiling above sign soffit pale. Ground tile warm beige stone.
Charcoal slate tile floor, dark feature wall with pattern, timber and navy-velvet chairs, wooden tables, timber-panel ceiling with recessed spots and a ~3m height; crowded.

photo_notes.where: 1F Famille Station, outdoor-style terrace seating beside Buddha's Belly
photo_notes.observed: Tall brick piers, big round planters with ficus trees, black metal bistro chairs/tables, queue stanchion. Reads as an indoor "street" with building facades (not a concourse).

Salmon/peach beige wall panels, black fascia with white round logo + "일상정원" in white sans (bold geometric), flat TV menu board, double glass doors with orange wood frames, queue stanchion & wood bench. Fascia ~2.8m high.

Very wide shot: central water channel with stones and green lotus-leaf props, timber counter seating on both sides, white cove-lit ceiling edges, tall plants, light timber lattice at far wall; ceiling ~4m.
Long narrow hall, light porcelain floor, cream booth sofas, cyan/white LED cove lighting along ceiling edges, round downlights; shows ceiling height ~3m and a ~2m aisle.

Whitewashed/grey brick facade with grid black-steel windows above, brick arch opening with wood-and-glass door, black stone paving at doorstep, vertical digital signage kiosk; European train-station/greenhouse styling.
Steel-truss glass roof with skylights, exposed pipe/ducts, amber pendant lamps, a railway-carriage-shaped booth in navy and mahogany with brass trim, dark grey slate floor, black chairs. Ceiling 6m+.
Tall steel columns and trusses, big glazed wall with grid mullions, copper/amber cone pendants, dark floor, black chairs with timber tables, mint green steel shelving unit.
Blue backlit sign "Agra" (white script/serif with round logo) over black fascia, orange brick piers both sides, white arched glass doors, terrazzo-speckled floor at entrance, A-frame menu stands.
White plaster arched wall niches with cove light, cream tufted banquettes, dark timber tables with copper pots, speckled stone floor; ceiling ~3m.

photo_notes.where: Centralcity retail floor (Le Jardin florist, near Famille Station)
photo_notes.observed: White backlit capital serif sign "LEJARDIN", cream classical fluted pilaster/column at right, three lit Christmas trees on pale marble floor, black glass cooler front.
White glossy large-format tile floor with warm LED strip at base of fixtures, black-framed glass flower coolers, planted displays, ceiling ~3m with spots.

photo_notes.where: Underground link from subway toward Shinsegae/CentralCity (Gate 5-ish)
photo_notes.observed: Black-framed glass revolving/sliding doors with "SHINSEGAE" red logo & gate number, grey stone-effect floor tile, dark marble wall, glass+steel stair rail at right, short-run yellow tactile strip.

photo_notes.where: Inside Shinsegae/CentralCity link corridor towards Megabox
photo_notes.observed: Wide corridor: polished cream/white marble floor with dark border bands, dark grey-black marble wall cladding and brown timber-framed shop fronts, coffered ceiling with illuminated frosted panel in gold-trimmed cornice, ~4m high, corridor ~8-10m wide, small kiosks/counters on right, wayfinding signs hung from ceiling.

photo_notes.where: Megabox Central entrance (blue neon MEGABOX sign)
photo_notes.observed: Cyan backlit "MEGABOX" block letters (squared, geometric sans) on a dark-brown timber portal, cream stone pilaster on the left, diagonal LED lines in ceiling, dark open lobby with blue-lit poster displays and a ticket gate. Old-style (pre-2025 refit may differ).

photo_notes.where: Upper-floor restaurant (모던샤브하우스 센트럴시티) with window to Banpo-daero/Express Bus Terminal side
photo_notes.observed: Curved wave-shaped cove-lit ceiling with recessed spots, floor-to-ceiling mullioned glass wall, round pillars, beige banquettes with timber screens, stone-grey floor. Ceiling ~3.5m. Useful for upper-floor restaurant feel (blog says 2-?F; exact floor unconfirmed).
